top_categories.workout_context: 77ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent's long, paved Spanish gran fondo with five climbs rewards road-specific control. Practice smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 112 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
At Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
At mile 60 of 112, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent. Train it until it feels boring.
8,635ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
8,635ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 112 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent’s 112 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Legendaria Gran Fondo Ontinyent rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on long, paved spanish gran fondo with five climbs to build confidence.
